build_EfficientNet_b0: build an EfficientNet b0 backbone model with default Swish activation and batch normalization
build_EfficientNet_arch: build an EfficientNet backbone with a specified architecture like b7 or el for object detection
create_EdgeResidual_block: create an EdgeResidual block with configurable kernel size, SE layer, and residual connection
test_EfficientNet_forward: test the EfficientNet backbone forward pass by passing a tensor and collecting stage outputs
refactor_model_scaling: refactor the model_scaling function to adjust width and depth scaling factors for a new architecture
